items.caption: A seal-script-style rendering of 見, the sound element conventionally identified in 現.
items.alt: A rounded upper form with two horizontal interior strokes above a curved, leg-like lower form.
items.selection_reason: This clearly depicts 見 and helps illustrate the conventional component analysis of 現. The rendering is modern and does not establish the component’s historical role in 現.

items.caption: A seal-script-style rendering of 玉, the jade element conventionally identified in 現.
items.alt: A vertical stroke crossed by three horizontal strokes, forming 玉 in a seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: This clearly depicts 玉 and illustrates the jade association in the conventional analysis of 現. It is a modern component drawing, not an early glyph of 現.

limitations.text: These modern component drawings do not show a historical form of 現 or establish its early graphic development. No character-specific historical glyph of 現 is verified here.
